phase-plan.purpose: Turn the docs-site content editor from a contract viewer into a real Payload-backed authoring system with project metadata, imported canonical pack/schema records, and export back to contract-shaped files for the game.
phase-plan.scope: In scope: Payload collections, generated Payload types, project import/export routes, content-app workspace, and export-file baseline. Out of scope: full per-pack CRUD editors, publish-to-bundle automation, and release distribution.

file.description: Registers new Payload collections for content projects, schema imports, and pack documents.
Project metadata collection for authoring workspaces.
Imported canonical schema metadata and source mapping per project/pack.
Contract-shaped pack documents stored in Payload per project.
Server utility that imports engine registry entries into Payload and exports project files.
Content app workspace for project creation, save, import, and export actions.

commands.command: pnpm --dir docs-site exec payload generate:types --config payload.config.ts

task.description: Add Payload collections and generated types for project, schema import, and pack document records.
Implement project create/update, canonical import, and export routes backed by Payload.
Turn the content-app content page into a working authoring workspace for the new Payload flow.

decision.summary: Payload is now the draft authoring store for content projects; the game still consumes exported contract-shaped files rather than direct DB reads.
decision.impact: Keeps runtime data deterministic and file-driven while enabling CRUD, project metadata, and revision-oriented authoring in the docs-site.
